description.value: Chase Public Library is part of the Thompson-Nicola Regional Library system and has served the Chase community since 1959, operating in its current 3,320-square-foot building since 1975 following renovations in 2003. Situated in the heart of Chase along the Shuswap corridor, it offers free Wi-Fi and public computers to all visitors, making it a practical rest stop for touring cyclists. The wheelchair-accessible facility is staffed and operates as a full-service branch of the regional library network.
